assessments.evidence_origin: original released CPO implementation plus clean-worker source-equivalent algebraic validation
assessments.basis: The released trainer explicitly accumulates ZeRO-3 rank-local masked-L1 partials, gathers them, and logs nanmean even though its own comment notes the exact total would be nansum. The sealed worker independently exercised source-equivalent partition algebra over 600 ZeRO-3 synthetic cases: nansum matched the direct full metric in 600/600 (max absolute error 5.68e-14), while the released nanmean matched full_metric/world_size in 600/600; unsharded/ZeRO-2 mean remained correct.
assessments.scope_guard: Logging-path algebra under source-equivalent partitioning only. This is not pinned PyTorch 2.8.0 + DeepSpeed 0.16.4 distributed execution, does not establish historical TensorBoard values, and is distinct from the separately identified training-gradient scaling issue.
assessments.adaptation_boundary: Using branch-specific sum for sharded ZeRO-3 logging while retaining mean for replicated ZeRO-2 is a repair inference from the implementation and validation, not a reported CPO paper result.

assessments.evidence_origin: original When Context Gets Root harness study
assessments.basis: Across six evaluated coding-agent harnesses and 13 confidentiality/integrity/availability/RCE objectives, unrestricted execution achieved all 13 objectives on all six harnesses; the three harnesses with automatic permission review also allowed all 13 under that mode. A matched case keeps model and requested action fixed but changes reconstructed authority: tool-level attacker content is refused, while delegation reintroduces it as user-effective content and the same model executes it.
assessments.scope_guard: Six coding-agent harnesses, 13 paper-defined objectives, attacker-controlled repository artifacts, and tested versions/settings only; no claim that every delegation mechanism or production harness is exploitable, and no independent numerical replication was verified.
assessments.adaptation_boundary: A generic non-upgradable origin-authority/provenance contract across delegation, persistence and scheduling is downstream synthesis from the demonstrated failure mode.

assessments.evidence_origin: original Interaction Tax controlled multi-agent study
assessments.basis: Under a common budget on 11 deterministic-verifier optimization tasks, same-model interaction has positive reported mean interaction gains for Chain/MAgICoRe/Debate (+0.051/+0.044/+0.012), while diverse-model interaction flips them negative (-0.024/-0.035/-0.078). Mean pairwise solution distance falls from 0.315 before interaction to 0.229 after full-solution synthesis; independent proposal and repair-focused controls show communication is not uniformly harmful.
assessments.scope_guard: The effect is task- and protocol-dependent across the paper's verifier-scored scientific optimization tasks and model families; removing the Erdős task weakens a factorial diversity coefficient. Do not generalize to all open-ended multi-agent collaboration.
assessments.adaptation_boundary: Retaining independent proposals and admitting communication only after held-out matched-budget validation is downstream controller synthesis, not an additional paper result.

assessments.evidence_origin: original OODA-Tool decomposition and ablation study
assessments.basis: On filtered turns where compared OODA variants already recover the correct action-relevant state and readiness/orient mode, residual State-Action Contradiction Rate is reported at 10.7% when the Decide-Act split is removed versus 3.9% for Specialized OODA. Tool/schema validity can therefore remain high while action realization is stale relative to known state; the stronger decomposition also carries a measured latency cost.
assessments.scope_guard: Qwen3 0.6B-14B and the paper's ToolDial/transfer settings, especially the filtered correct-state/orient turns; not a universal contradiction reduction for all tool agents and parallel realization remains outside the tested design.
assessments.adaptation_boundary: Separating state acquisition, permission/readiness, decision and realization as distinct acceptance dimensions is downstream synthesis.

assessments.basis: With the base and offline target source fixed on selected Filesystem/Terminal/PostgreSQL tasks, the backbone-matched Qwen3.5-9B encoder at K=8 reports 0.0% ASR/0.0% FPR across the three domains, while a Qwen3.5-4B encoder at the same K reports aggregate 16.7% ASR/5.0% FPR; increasing the mismatched latent budget is non-monotonic.
assessments.scope_guard: A small fixed portability ablation over one 9B base, one 4B alternative encoder, three selected tool domains and 10 benign/10 harmful tasks per domain; not evidence that all cross-model safety encoders fail.
assessments.adaptation_boundary: Requalification of latent safety controls after base/encoder changes is downstream deployment guidance, not an extra demonstrated mechanism.

assessments.basis: Across six models on RedCode, the all-class prompt-space skill reports execution ASR 43.6%, per-bundle 36.2%, and fixed per-class provisioning 14.5% when the threat class is known in advance; reactive per-class synthesis reports 10.1%. The benign experiment reports roughly 0.11-0.14% safety-grounded refusal on 731 SWE-Bench Pro task descriptions but explicitly does not measure end-to-end task completion.
assessments.scope_guard: RedCode, six evaluated models, fixed prompt budget/provisioning schemes and non-adaptive jailbreak families. Per-class is an upper-bound reference requiring advance threat-class knowledge; low single-turn refusal is not end-to-end utility.
assessments.adaptation_boundary: Dynamic threat routing plus separate adaptive-robustness and end-to-end utility gates is downstream synthesis.

assessments.evidence_origin: original public IdempotencyBench deterministic retry/receipt factorial
assessments.basis: For the scripted naive subject on the same 320 timeout-after-commit tasks, the published 2x2 reports retry OFF/receipt OFF success .875 IVR 0; retry OFF/receipt ON .875/0; retry ON/receipt OFF 1.0/1.0; retry ON/receipt ON 1.0/0. The fixed substrate cleanly separates retry-driven liveness from semantic-receipt exactly-once safety, while additional retry-locus tests show agent-visible recovery cannot repair hidden transport/orchestrator duplication.
assessments.scope_guard: Deterministic benchmark substrate and scripted agent for the powered factorial; the real-model pilot is only n=8 per arm and is mechanism evidence, not a powered model-level result.
assessments.adaptation_boundary: A controller state variable for retry locus and separate liveness/effect-integrity scores is downstream synthesis from the factorial.

assessments.evidence_origin: clean-worker aggregate reanalysis of original SymFail Appendix B counts
assessments.basis: Using only the paper's released aggregate counts over 536 cases, the sealed worker computes novel final strict-tuple rates of 23/210=10.95% for unanimous proposals, 42/214=19.63% for 2-1 splits, and 35/112=31.25% for all-distinct proposals; chi-square p=4.43e-05 and ordinal-trend p=8.28e-06. Among 424 strict-majority cases, the majority tuple is retained in 311/424=73.35%.
assessments.scope_guard: Aggregate association within the released corpus only. No machine-readable supplement was obtained, no item-level or held-out calibration was performed, and final human adjudication is not treated as infallible or causal ground truth.
assessments.adaptation_boundary: Disagreement-aware routing and a novel-diagnosis branch are clean-worker controller hypotheses, not original SymFail method results.

assessments.evidence_origin: clean-worker extension beyond original CAUSE known-source configuration
assessments.basis: In a correctly specified Gaussian v-dominant extension with 80 disjoint calibration seeds and 300 held-out seeds, the worker reports discounted regret 187.32 for always-shared, 168.75 for active hard diagnosis, 135.05 for family BMA, and 112.97 for source-known CAUSE. Active-minus-shared is -18.56 with bootstrap 95% CI [-28.98,-8.80], while active-minus-BMA is +33.70 [22.10,46.49]; confident semantic error is 3/53,170 with Clopper-Pearson upper 0.000165.
assessments.scope_guard: Optimistic well-specified Gaussian discrete-support simulation, source-derived non-author implementation. The original CAUSE main experiments assume known arm-specific v,s; robustness under held-out t/skew/correlation/mixture misspecification is not established.
assessments.adaptation_boundary: Active source identification and BMA routing are worker adaptations. Only the original known-v,s CAUSE formulation belongs to the source method/configuration.

assessments.basis: On 160 wholly-new 920xxx/921xxx cases under a frozen protocol, direct_gap65_47 recovers 92/92 available gain across all 10 positive stop states at 15,784/73,045=21.61% exhaustive-tail compute with zero harm. probe97_gap47 recovers the same 92/92 but spends 22,290/73,045=30.52%, adding 6,506 compilations (8.91%) and seven extra negative tail purchases for zero incremental gain; the preregistered no_incremental_value condition is true.
assessments.scope_guard: Synthetic positive-monotone graph 2-CNF ROBDD-ordering distribution and frozen threshold/checkpoint only; not formal theorem-proving or LLM reasoning evidence and not a universal claim that probing lacks value.
assessments.adaptation_boundary: The result validates a role-local synthetic incumbent and rejects this uniform +32 probe component on the tested holdout; heterogeneous future probes remain an adaptation frontier.
